items.title: Karl Berger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, August 11, 2014
items.q: You remind me of Roswell Rudd.

ctx.x: When people come for those three days, that’s what they do all day. They play and sing and practice rhythms and so on. Exactly. But the idea is also, this is not just some kind of — this is like going into more precision, not less. Like thinking, in our world we think of the world of precision being a lot of thinking. It’s not. Music is much more precise. More detailed. You’re really going into a lot more detail about life and about things and about vibration — the vibrational quality that we actually live in but…
You remind me of Roswell Rudd.
